name: Comedy Cellar
rooms: MacDougal Street room; Village Underground and Fat Black Pussycat (bar and lounge) around the corner
address: 117 MacDougal St and 130 W 3rd St, Manhattan
price_label: $15 Mon–Wed · $18 Thu & Sun · $25 Fri & Sat · $25 holidays
minimum: Two items per person: food, drink, or a bottle of water
age: 21+ (email for exceptions at 18 with a parent)
reservations: Online. Parties up to 8 on MacDougal, up to 4 at Fat Black Pussycat
character: The famous low basement room. Drop-ins by big names happen, but the booked lineup is the point. Weeknights are the value.
verification_note: Prices, minimum, age and party limits from the reservations page; addresses from the contact page.

name: The Stand
rooms: Main showroom over a full-service restaurant
minimum: No drink minimum; full table service
age: 16+, with at least one person in the party 21+
reservations: Buy ahead; check in 30 minutes before, seating opens 15 minutes before. Shows run 90 minutes.
character: A restaurant-first club with a polished room and dependable lineups. The no-minimum policy makes the ticket the real price.
verification_note: Re-read directly from the live FAQ page (browser, 2026-09-13). Age policy and 90-minute show length confirmed; earlier 403 blocking the fetcher no longer affects direct browser access.

name: New York Comedy Club
rooms: Three clubs: 24th Street (Kips Bay, billed as Midtown), East Village, Upper West Side
address: 241 E 24th St · 85 E 4th St · 236 W 78th St, Manhattan
neighborhood: Kips Bay · East Village · Upper West Side
price_label: Varies by show; see the show page
minimum: $20 showroom minimum per person, plus tax and an automatic 18% gratuity
age: 18+ (16+ with an adult, at the club's discretion)

character: Small rooms, lots of shows, plenty of working comics on any night. Budget the minimum on top of the ticket.
verification_note: Minimum, age and seating from the club FAQ. Ticket prices not stated there.

name: Gotham Comedy Club
price_label: Varies by show; roughly $17 and up
reservations: Arrive 30 minutes before showtime with photo ID and the purchasing card. Non-refundable. First come, first served; partial parties not seated.
character: The big, comfortable Chelsea room with the All-Stars format most nights. Less cramped than the Village basements.
verification_note: Minimum, age, arrival and ID rules from the purchase policy page. Price range from one listed event; varies.

character: The Theater District option. Since 1986, tourist-friendly, and the minimum is transparent.
verification_note: Minimum, age, arrival and ticket tiers from the FAQ. Ticket prices not stated there.

name: Comedy In Harlem
rooms: One room with a full kitchen and bar, at St Nicholas Ave and 147th St, steps from the 145th St A/B/C/D
price_label: $5 Tuesday competition · $20 to $25 most ticketed shows
minimum: $18 food and drink per person at ticketed shows

minimum: Two-item minimum inside the showroom (per the club's own event listing)
age: 17+ without a guardian; under 17 admitted only with a guardian
character: The oldest showcase club in the city — opened May 1975 by Tienken, McGowan, and Wachs. Same Upper East Side room, same Jerry-Seinfeld-broke-here lineage.

name: The Fear City Comedy Club
rooms: 60-seat dry 'killbox' room in a former boxing gym on the Chinatown/LES border
price_label: $20 online · $25 at the door (per current show listings)
minimum: None — the club is dry, with non-alcoholic beverages and no drink minimum
age: Not stated on the venue site; confirm on the show page
reservations: Online through the club's WooCommerce store; door sales if the show hasn't sold out
character: A small dry room on the LES, with hour-long shows most nights mixing established New York comics, touring headliners and producers' showcases (Big Red, Max-Out, Magic City, Pure Chaos). The name comes from the 1975 'Welcome to Fear City' NYPD pamphlet; Jonezy Karona opened the club after decades in the city's music scene.
source_label: Origin Story (no drink minimum, dry room, 60 seats) + a current show listing (Boston's Funniest, $20 online / $25 door)
verification_note: Read from the club's own Origin Story block ('No bartenders, no servers, no drink minimums - no distractions'; '60 seat killbox comedy club serving non-alcoholic beverages') and one current WooCommerce show listing that lists the price. Address '17 Essex Street, New York, NY 10002' confirmed in the Google Maps embed on the same page. Hours on the shows page footer: Monday–Sunday 4:00pm–midnight.
